contract.qualification: Source-evidenced safe simulated sensorless root; NOT full firmware boot, calibrated mainboard, IR transmitter, BLE mesh network or hardware clone.

wire.outer_key_selection: outer.i==0 selects startup session key; any nonzero i selects generic key. No inferred GCM, IV or trailing-brace stripping.
wire.authorization: i selects only the decrypt key. No separate i-based bind/status/command permission check occurs in the traced inner dispatcher. Reply i is operation-derived independently of request key.
wire.outer_datagram_suffix: LF byte0x0a after serialized outer JSON, NUL terminated in RAM; send includes LF, not NUL. W05G0x80657da..0x80657e8 stores LF then caller stores NUL and sends old strlen+1. No encrypted-inner LF is evidenced.
wire.padding: PKCS7 including aligned full block. Native encrypt wrapper rejects nonempty inputs shorter than16. Native decrypt leaves padding untouched; cJSON parse consumes a prefix. Safe emulator validates/removes PKCS7 rather than reproducing unsafe parser acceptance.
wire.base64: Pinned RTL8710B ROM base64_decode0x3523c/base64_encode0x35110 explicitly substituted by standard-library base64 in outer-route probes.
wire.session_lifecycle: Supplied synthetic session key in probes. Bind returns existing startup session key; no rebind rotation observed in handler. Simulated key must be deterministic per seeded device, not a shared global key.

scratch_limits.bounded_encoder_policy: Require PKCS7 padded ciphertext <=1024 and base64 encoded ciphertext plus terminating NUL <=1024 before any command mutation. The latter bound is tighter. A1024-byte UDP receive limit is not a proven1024-byte maximum heap-serialized outer reply.
scratch_limits.source: Exact native receive loops and reply/crypto callsites in source-contract-map.json; base64 ABI capacity is the dlen input at each SDK call.

outer_reply.uid: last numeric outer uid;0 at synthetic startup

wire.reply_constructor_boundary: Native inner constructors executed to cJSON serialization boundary; exact serialized whitespace/ciphertext of firmware replies is NOT claimed.

safe_parser_policy.requests: Strict outer/inner objects and expected string/integer/array types; reject bool as integer. Equal opt/p lengths, finite integer values, bound original bytes before decryption, validate entire batch before cache or clock mutation, reject unsafe identity/private/unknown state overrides.
safe_parser_policy.unsupported_operations: All44 distinct source selectors/60 records are modeled with independent raw scratch/readout and synthetic queues. Queue ACKs do not claim BLE delivery, OTA execution, network reconnection, physical children or persistence hardware success.
safe_parser_policy.reply_size: Bound full encrypted/outer reply before mutation;1024-byte receive does not prove a larger reply buffer.

simulation_policy.initial_cache: Fresh per-device modeled numeric cache zeros; this is a literal simulation policy, not native startup/mainboard data.
simulation_policy.key: Independent seeded per-device16-byte session key; restart/rebind stable by explicit model policy.
simulation_policy.physical_calibration: None claimed. Do not synthesize TemSen, calibration, or inherited AC temperature behavior.
simulation_policy.modeled_readable_fields: Use isolated_status_from_zero_synthetic_platform as the exact source output catalog, including known columns without values. hid/mac dynamic by profile; placeholders and unsupported callback outputs must not be promoted into typed features.
simulation_policy.root_command_policy: Pow is a transport command/cache, not gateway physical power or an ambient appliance. Numeric p echoes original integer. No invented Pow status value. Source cache/queue is distinct from synthetic mesh/BLE physical state.
simulation_policy.topology: This contract is an empty, sensorless root gateway only. No invented attachable child profiles, MAC widths, pagination or mainboard schema.
simulation_policy.action_commands: Source-qualified receipt/cache/queue semantics use explicit synthetic in-memory backing. No delivered BLE/OTA/network effect follows from ACK or queue admission; see session-realtek-w05g-quirks_research.json.
simulation_policy.native_status_limit: time remains separately modeled RTC; source-empty ver/vender/host/name/location are not their scan strings.

unexecuted_dependencies.policy: Synthetic ISO-like time string permitted only when explicitly documented as modeled clock; no native RTC time result claimed.

routing.status: outer.tcid must equal root; inner.mac ignored
routing.command: outer.tcid must equal root; inner.mac ignored

native_semantics.status: Finite60 selector table, including repeated NoD placeholders. A known selector is appended to cols before its callback. Some known selectors (including Pow) append NO dat; unknown names append neither. This is not a one-value-per-column readable namespace.
native_semantics.command: Numeric cache store low16 but ACK p keeps original cJSON integer, so duplicatePow[7,65537] -> p[7,65537]; native queue side effect completes in source RAM. Fresh Pow status remains cols[Pow],dat[]. String command routes have separate parsing and BLE/host/credentials side effects and are not generic numeric appliance controls.
native_semantics.empty_topology: Subcount0. SubOnline is a JSON-encoded string "[]", not a nested array; first3 parent descriptors plus49 secondary descriptors are distinct source loops. No child model is qualified here.
native_semantics.special_shape: BleKey can append TWO data values for one column. Do not import client equal-length assumptions.
